model: List append copies one cons per element of its left list; count only the leaves construction copies, omitting every other owner-scan operation.
literalSource: RMAF.leaves (.node l r) = leaves l ++ leaves r; AllGoodDP.owner rebuilds leaves s inside the findIdx predicate for each queried target leaf.
formula: L*(L-1)/2 copies per source-list construction; L^2*(L-1)/2 across L target leaf owners; author4*(2L-1)*(2L+1).
negativeControl: replace per-query copy count by L-1 and require exact comparison to reject
scope: Refutes one displayed linear owner helper sub-bound under the stated list/copy model. Does not refute exact minimum, final loose degree6 envelope, or machine runtime. No partition census or extra replication.
